mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participants ( id, space_id, event_id, name, phone, phone_hash, phone_last4, phone_key, pin_hash, pin_temporary, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{phoneHash}, #{phoneLast4}, #{phoneKey}, #{pinHash}, false, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.space_id, p.event_id, p.name, p.phone, p.pin_hash, p.pin_temporary, (SELECT a.id FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = p.space_id AND a.event_id = p.event_id AND a.participant_id = p.id AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') AS application_id FROM participants p
mapper.select: WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.phone_key = #{phoneKey}
WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.id = #{participantId}
